business_problem: However, years of growth through mergers left the company with fragmented systems, siloed data and low trust in AI.
solution_summary: DXC Technology, a global leader in IT services, set out to boost productivity and streamline operations by developing 3 generative AI agents across sales, HR, finance and project management. However, years of growth through mergers left the company with fragmented systems, siloed data and low trust in AI. DXC turned to the Databricks Data + AI Platform to unify data, enable governed access and accelerate AI development with a single, scalable environment. As a result, DXC cut time-to-insight from months to days, reduced platform total cost of ownership (TCO) by 30% and empowered teams across the business to build and deploy AI solutions faster and with greater confidence.
